g.text: MarieRank5Convo1 begins.
May we speak ?
Evaluate expressions
I have been thinking over what you said about le Cardinal. That his actions are... a "mix" of benign and foul.
MarieEntrati4a
I have been thinking over your words about le Cardinal. That his actions have brought pain to Lyon.
MarieEntrati4b
I have been thinking more on our conversation regarding M'sieur Tagfer, and your convincing arguments for why he despises le Cardinal so.
MarieEntrati3a
I have been thinking more on my argument with M'sieur Tagfer, and his reasons for despising le Cardinal so.
MarieEntrati3b
I have been thinking more on my argument with M'sieur Tagfer. And our argument about that argument.
MarieEntrati3
I feel a great much has been left unsaid regarding le Cardinal. The others seem to walk on eggshells around me, afraid to speak of him.
false
I know others wish to paint him a cur, a madman, a traitor. But he was not those things to me.
Check boolean MarieBackstory1
Perhaps it is because I am so accustomed to being abandoned.
true
I was abandoned by my family, left on the streets when I was a child, due to being... abnormal. Broken. Unfit for high society.
false
Perhaps it is because I never had a father to speak of, that I am so willing to forgive him for his absence.
Evaluate expressions
But the fact remains that I do forgive him. For I see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
MarieEntrati4a
I pray that Lyon is strong and survives the crisis of faith he suffers, but I do not believe it to be entirely a fault of le Cardinal's making.
MarieEntrati4b
So while I appreciate your convincing arguments regarding M'sieur Tagfer and those who have been harmed by him... I still see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
MarieEntrati3a

So while I appreciate M'sieur Tagfer's ire, and can sympathize with his points, he must find the space in his own heart to forgive le Cardinal. For I see more value in le Cardinal's good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
MarieEntrati3b
So while I appreciate everyone's histories with le Cardinal, especially M'Sieur Tagfer, I still more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
MarieEntrati3
So while I appreciate everyone's histories with le Cardinal, I still more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
false
I don't fault you for appreciating the good he's done in your life, the same way I don't fault other people for resenting the harm he's causing in theirs.
I don't know. I think his actions have led to a lot more harm than good. I wish you could see that.
I'm siding with you, Marie. I can't fault Entrati for any of what he's done. He's fighting the Indifference.
You're right to forgive Entrati. I wish more of the others would follow your lead.
I'll never fault someone for forgiveness. But you can forgive someone while understanding you have to protect yourself and others from them.
You think Lyon's suffering is his own fault?
Lyon is suffering far more than a crisis of faith, Marie. And a lot of that has to do with Entrati.
Did nothing I said even slightly work to even the scales?
How can you look at everything Entrati has done and still see more good than harm?
I think you're downplaying the seriousness of what the Cavia and Tagfer suffered.
Forgiveness is important. But so is acknowledging that Entrati might be more complicated than you're willing to accept.
I still don't think you understand what Tagfer and the Cavia suffered. It's worse than what you went through.
But do you see how the two are not of equal value ? Resentment and veneration ? I wish for the others to give up their malicious grudges.
Evaluate expressions
Evaluate expressions
And is that what you suggest we do ? Outcast le Cardinal ? I would argue that seems to be what he has done to himself, non ?
I think Lyon suffers from many ailments, much of which owing to doubt in himself and his own mind. Le Cardinal seems to have... only quickened matters.
What would you have me do ? Burn an effigy of le Cardinal and denounce him ? Condemn him to the Void, wish him harm like M'sieur Tagfer ?
That's the issue, Marie. What you're asking of other people. Not what they're asking of you. Or of Entrati.
Entrati leaves hurt people wherever he goes. All I'm trying to do is help those people put everything back together. I don't care much about "good" or "evil" in his case.
Oui, and you are so consistent in your hatred for him ! Has nothing I have said done to soften you le Cardinal in turn ?
MarieEntratiMonster1
MarieEntratiMonster2
Were you not speaking to me of how you favored Entrati, same as I, not but moments ago ? What has now changed your mind ?
MarieEntratiFan1
MarieEntratiFan2
Oui, and you seem to think Entrati such a monstre ! You are so quick to dismiss his kindness in turn !
false
Were you not speaking to me of Entrati's monstruosité just moments prior ? What has now changed your mind ?
MarieEntratiMonster1
MarieEntratiMonster2
Merci, and you have been my stalwart companion on this crusade ! I fear that we are alone in such regard - even Monsieur Loid harbors such resentment...
MarieEntratiFan1
MarieEntratiFan2
Merci, and how glad I am to hear it ! I fear that we are alone in such regard - even Monsieur Loid harbors such resentment...
false
I think the issue is more what you're asking of others, not what they're asking of you. Or Entrati.
And it doesn't bother you?
And what is it that I am asking of others that is so grotesque ? To accept forgiveness into their hearts ?
Noble, if tiresome, to travel through time and space, aiding his mécontents, non ? Surely you must resent him for this...
This conversation was a mistake...
I honestly have been struggling to navigate this topic with you. Painfully so. I personally think he's... neither good nor bad. But a mix.
I've changed my mind. I'm on his side. And yours. You convinced me.
[Confess feelings.] I've just been trying to do my best to... get on your good side, I'm afraid. I have feelings for you. More than I let on.
I've changed my mind and decided he's a monster. Once and for all.
Together, perhaps we can stand guard against those who would besmirch his good deeds, oui ? But I wonder, against all that surrounds you... why take my side ?
Check boolean LyonDating
You've put Entrati on a pedestal, Marie. And you're asking others to do the same thing like idiots.
I think you're asking them to do more than to just forgive Entrati. I think you're asking them to pretend nothing he did was ever wrong at all.
Sure. But I also have him to "thank" for some of the most important relationships and friendships I've ever made.
No, not really. He needs me to do it, so I'll do it. I'll judge him when all is said and done.
Wait, Marie. Please. Let me explain.
I've made it clear how I feel about Entrati. I'm sorry. On some things, we can't see eye-to-eye.
Update boolean MarieEntratiMonster1
Update boolean MarieEntratiMonster1
Update boolean DrifterMarieWhoops
Update boolean MarieEntratiFan1
Not that I am complaining, mind !
I know he has found a place inside your heart, and for this I am so truly grateful - perhaps I can finally stop worrying about him, and all this fighting will soon be moot -
true
But of course it bothers me. He is the brother of my soul ! My Lyon is the dearest thing in this world to me, and to see him in pain brings an ache in my chest as if his agonie is my own.
false
Watch your words, Drifter.
Je ne suis pas naïve, do not speak to me as if I am such !
Perhaps he is only lancing a poison so that the body can heal, and this is all merely a necessary cruelty.
[Confess feelings.] I care about you. More than I've let on. And I... I'm sorry I've been harsh, but I can't let him hurt you. Not like he's hurt so many others.
I have watched Entrati do nothing but burn everyone he cares about. Everyone he has supposedly loved. I don't want to see him do the same to you...
I'm not the best at expressing myself, and for that I'm sorry. But he's... I'm afraid he's using you, and using your kindness to manipulate you. That's all.
You may see Entrati as a savior, but I see him as an old, frightened man scrambling for answers. Maybe the answer is somewhere in between.
Oui. It seems so.
Update boolean MarieEntratiMonster2
Update boolean MarieEntratiMonster2
And you have decided to deceive me to get into my good graces... je vois.
Update boolean MarieEntratiFan2
[Confess feelings.] I care about you. More than I've let on.
I believe anything is necessary in this war. We're trying to save the universe against the Indifference, after all, aren't we?
I believe in Entrati. Honestly. I think he has a plan to solve this, and all this has been for the ultimate good.
But his fall from faith is not the doing of le Cardinal. The crack in the foundations were there. More pressure was simply added, oui ?
Update boolean MarieWarning
I am well aware le Cardinal is both Lua and Sol - light and dark - good and evil. He is neither, and both, and capable of kindness and cruelty.
This is why the others get upset when you talk about him. You gloss over everything he's done that's hurt them and pretend it hasn't happened like idiots.
Marie, stop. You need to accept that he's not doing this all purely because he's a good man. He's not. He's more complicated than that.
Update boolean DrifterMarie
Watch your words, Drifter.
I do not need to be protected like I am ! Je ne suis pas une enfant naïve !

Marie, he isn't a god. He's just a man. He's just as arrogant and just as dangerous as Roathe. He comes from the same society and suffers all the same problems.
I know he was kind to you. I know he was different to you maybe than he has been to a lot of people. Maybe he even treated you like a daughter... But look at the bigger picture, please.
I - I do not know how to handle this news, given... given our current conversation. I am taken... quite aback by this.

He is a man who summoned - or perhaps even created - a god ! And now is the only one who stands between it and destruction of our universe !
You think I do not know that I was not the only "daughter" he abandoned ?! I am merely the only one who forgives !
Do you truly mean to do this now ?! Like this ?! Here ?! Vraiment ?!
Oui ? I will...forgive you this lie, but consider yourself warned. Choose your words more carefully, Drifter...
